versions.description: In-game polls. Admins start a timed poll with numbered options, players vote with pollvote <n> (one vote each, changeable until the poll closes), anyone can check live results with poll. When the poll ends or an admin closes it early, the results are broadcast, optionally posted to Discord, and voters can get a small currency reward.

commands.name: poll
commands.description: Show the live poll results. Admins: poll create <minutes> <question> | <option1> | <option2> ... and poll close.
commands.helpText: poll = live results. poll create <minutes> <question> | <option1> | <option2> | ... (POLLS_MANAGE). poll close = end the poll now (POLLS_MANAGE).

commands.name: pollvote
commands.description: Vote for an option of the running poll. You can change your vote until the poll closes.
commands.helpText: pollvote <number> - vote for option <number> of the running poll.

arguments.name: option
arguments.helpText: The option number to vote for.

cronJobs.name: poll-tick
cronJobs.description: Closes the running poll once its time is up.
